title: Semester registration closes soon
message: Complete your course enrollment on the Courses page before 30 Aug 2026. Late registration incurs a fee.

title: Mid-semester exam schedule released
message: Mid-sem exams begin 15 Sep 2026. Download your seat allocation from the Grades page.

title: Hackathon 2026 team registration open
message: Register your team of up to 4 members by 5 Sep for the annual 24-hour build sprint.

title: Library timing extended for exams
message: The central library will remain open until midnight from 1 Sep through the exam period.

title: Placement drive: pre-placement talks
message: Pre-placement talks for final-year students begin next month. Keep your profile updated.

title: Fee payment deadline reminder
message: Semester fee payment closes 31 Aug 2026. Pay online through the student portal to avoid a late fee.

title: Guest lecture on Cloud Computing
message: An industry expert session on cloud-native architectures will be held in Seminar Hall 2.

title: Sports day 2026 — event schedule
message: Annual sports day events including athletics, cricket and badminton begin 10 Sep 2026.

title: Internal assessment marks published
message: IA marks for all courses are now visible on the Grades page. Report discrepancies within 5 days.

title: Wi-Fi maintenance window this weekend
message: Campus Wi-Fi will be intermittently unavailable on Saturday 9 Aug between 1 AM and 5 AM.

title: Campus recruitment: TechNova Systems
message: TechNova Systems will conduct on-campus interviews on 20 Aug. Eligible students must apply by 12 Aug.

title: Workshop on Git & GitHub for beginners
message: A hands-on version control workshop will be held for first and second year students.

title: Cultural fest 2026 registrations open
message: Register for dance, music and drama events for the annual cultural fest by 25 Aug.

title: Revised academic calendar uploaded
message: The revised calendar reflecting the updated exam dates is available on the Timetable page.

title: Scholarship application window open
message: Merit scholarship applications for this semester close on 15 Aug. Submit documents to the accounts office.

title: Placement drive: resume review sessions
message: One-on-one resume review slots are available with the placement cell — book via the Placement portal.

title: Convocation rehearsal schedule
message: Graduating students must attend the rehearsal session as per their allotted time slot.

title: Re-evaluation request window open
message: Students may apply for answer sheet re-evaluation within 7 days of result publication.
